entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The thump of airplane wheels on asp..."
entries.dialogueText: The thump of airplane wheels on asphalt jolted me from my sleep.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was seated in the commercial jet..."
entries.dialogueText: I was seated in the commercial jet we'd chartered for our royal visit to Thornbough. It had been a long, bumpy ride.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As we descended the airplane stairs..."
entries.dialogueText: As we descended the airplane stairs onto the tarmac, a horn quartet played a jubilant fanfare. Photographers in a cordoned-off press area eagerly began snapping pictures.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A red carpet stretched from the pla..."
entries.dialogueText: A red carpet stretched from the plane to a waiting motorcade. Next to a pair of limousines, Beatrice Livingston and the Rumburg royal family waited to greet us.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Queen regarded me politely, but..."
entries.dialogueText: The Queen regarded me politely, but with some remove. She held out her hand.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I kissed my sister-in-law's hand. S..."
entries.dialogueText: I kissed my sister-in-law's hand. She gave a prim smile of approval.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I shook my sister-in-law's hand. Sh..."
entries.dialogueText: I shook my sister-in-law's hand. She rapidly withdrew it.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I attempted to embrace my sister-in..."
entries.dialogueText: I attempted to embrace my sister-in-law. She hugged me back only briefly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The queen's eyes brimmed with sympa..."
entries.dialogueText: The queen's eyes brimmed with sympathy as I approached. She pulled me into an embrace.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The queen had a compassionate look..."
entries.dialogueText: The queen had a compassionate look in her eyes as I approached. We exchanged cheek kisses.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""My dear, dear brother-in-law. You'..."
entries.dialogueText: "My dear, dear brother-in-law. You've gotten yourself into quite the mess, haven't you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing Rumburg can't get me out o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing Rumburg can't get me out of."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""My dear brother-in-law. What a ple..."
entries.dialogueText: "My dear brother-in-law. What a pleasure it is to finally host you in Thornbourgh."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Romus, Your Majesty. You've gotten..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, Your Majesty. You've gotten yourself into quite the mess."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Romus, Your Majesty. It has been s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Romus, Your Majesty. It has been some time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nonsense. Everything in Pales is p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonsense. Everything in Pales is perfectly under control."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's almost a good thing your sist..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's almost a good thing your sister didn't live to see these times."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Mess' is an understatement.""
entries.dialogueText: "'Mess' is an understatement."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stepped back with a scandalized..."
entries.dialogueText: She stepped back with a scandalized look on her face.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Yes, well, fear not.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, well, fear not."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""That is the idea.""
entries.dialogueText: "That is the idea."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It will only be under control once..."
entries.dialogueText: "It will only be under control once you have won."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm looking forward to your legend..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm looking forward to your legendary Rumburgian hospitality."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your niece sends her warmest wishe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your niece sends her warmest wishes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nothing Rumburg can't get me out o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nothing Rumburg can't get me out of."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Nonsense. Everything in Pales is p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonsense. Everything in Pales is perfectly under control."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's almost a good thing your sist..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's almost a good thing your sister didn't live to see these times. Almost."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not a mess. It's a catastroph..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not a mess. It's a catastrophe."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She stepped back with a horrified l..."
entries.dialogueText: She stepped back with a horrified look on her face.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I was speaking euphemistically. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was speaking euphemistically. It's the Rumburgian way."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""We will see about that.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will see about that."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I was not only speaking about Pale..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was not only speaking about Pales."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Please refrain from such attempts..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please refrain from such attempts at 'comedy'."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed, Your Excellency. How have..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Your Excellency. How have you been?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Really? I feel like I just saw you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Really? I feel like I just saw you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""An eternity, and yet no time at al..."
entries.dialogueText: "An eternity, and yet no time at all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your niece sends her warmest wishe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your niece sends her warmest wishes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know we've drifted apart over th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know we've drifted apart over the past years, but it's a pleasure to be here."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Drifted apart. Yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Drifted apart. Yes."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I have been better. As have you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have been better. As have you."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""A pity she could not be here.""
entries.dialogueText: "A pity she could not be here."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""How lovely. I'm just dying to hear..."
entries.dialogueText: "How lovely. I'm just dying to hear about her time in the Grand Duchy."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""How lovely. A pity she could not b..."
entries.dialogueText: "How lovely. A pity she could not be here."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll have to make this a quick vi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll have to make this a quick visit, I'm afraid. Turbulent times back home."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You will not be disappointed. Eith..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will not be disappointed. Either of you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: She raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""So I hear.""
entries.dialogueText: "So I hear."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Really? From where I'm sitting, yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really? From where I'm sitting, your reign looks smooth as silk."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""If that was a joke, it's not very..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that was a joke, it's not very amusing."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Surely you are being facetious. So..."
entries.dialogueText: "Surely you are being facetious. So much has changed."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Hrm, yes. Poetic.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hrm, yes. Poetic."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had just finished getting dressed..."
entries.dialogueText: I had just finished getting dressed when Lucita entered the compartment. She was outfitted in full military regalia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was in the bedroom of my royal je..."
entries.dialogueText: I was in the bedroom of my royal jet, {RiziaDLCText.RoyalJet}. It had been a long but smooth flight to Thornbourgh.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had just finished getting dressed..."
entries.dialogueText: I had just finished getting dressed when I heard a knock on the door to my compartment.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I love a woman in uniform.""
entries.dialogueText: "I love a woman in uniform."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had just finished getting dressed..."
entries.dialogueText: I had just finished getting dressed when I heard a knock on the door to my compartment.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Your Majesty? Are you decent?""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty? Are you decent?"

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your Majesty? Are you decent?""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty? Are you decent?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Decent, no. Dressed, yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Decent, no. Dressed, yes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is it?""
entries.dialogueText: "What is it?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You may enter.""
entries.dialogueText: "You may enter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Ready to meet my sister-in-law?""
entries.dialogueText: "Ready to meet my sister-in-law?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How dare you barge in on me like t..."
entries.dialogueText: "How dare you barge in on me like that? I could've been naked."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You can't see it, but I'm saluting..."
entries.dialogueText: "You can't see it, but I'm saluting you right now."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She bowed in faux humility."
entries.dialogueText: She bowed in faux humility.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She grimaced."
entries.dialogueText: She grimaced.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's been more than a decade. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's been more than a decade. You are in-laws no longer."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She flashed me a grin."
entries.dialogueText: She flashed me a grin.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""At your service, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "At your service, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Apologies, Your Majesty. Next time..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apologies, Your Majesty. Next time I'll barge in earlier."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have always tried my hardest to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have always tried my hardest to be a decent man and a decent king."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a smile, she entered."
entries.dialogueText: With a smile, she entered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She sat next to me on the bed and s..."
entries.dialogueText: She sat next to me on the bed and squeezed my hand.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I hope the Queen's in a good mood...."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope the Queen's in a good mood. Rumburg's support could really turn the tide against Pales."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a smile, he entered."
entries.dialogueText: With a smile, he entered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She came in and bowed."
entries.dialogueText: She came in and bowed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He came in and bowed."
entries.dialogueText: He came in and bowed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita was in the seat next to mine..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita was in the seat next to mine. On seeing I was awake, she squeezed my hand surreptitiously.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita was in the seat next to mine..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita was in the seat next to mine. On seeing I was awake, she smiled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento was in the seat next to mi..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento was in the seat next to mine. On seeing I was awake, he smiled.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Good morning, Your Majesty. I'm gl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good morning, Your Majesty. I'm glad you were able to get some rest."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Good morning, Your Majesty. I'm gl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good morning, Your Majesty. I'm glad you were able to get some rest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Are you joking? I can hardly sleep..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you joking? I can hardly sleep in my own bed, let alone on an airplane."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I always sleep well on airplanes...."
entries.dialogueText: "I always sleep well on airplanes. No phone calls or letters, no responsibilities except to get from point A to point B."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It wasn't easy. I've been nervous..."
entries.dialogueText: "It wasn't easy. I've been nervous about today's meeting."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was having the most marvelous dr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was having the most marvelous dream. I think you were involved."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Really? That's quite the honor.""
entries.dialogueText: "Really? That's quite the honor."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""How fascinating. I suggest we unpa..."
entries.dialogueText: "How fascinating. I suggest we unpack its meaning in private later."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What an honor, Your Majesty. I ass..."
entries.dialogueText: "What an honor, Your Majesty. I assume I was clothed."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Ah. Your father was the same way...."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah. Your father was the same way. Restless till the end."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Sorry to hear. I've trained myself..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sorry to hear. I've trained myself to be able to sleep on any surface."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Your military training didn't take..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your military training didn't take, then. They taught me to be able to sleep anywhere."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Refreshing, I agree.""
entries.dialogueText: "Refreshing, I agree."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Understandably so.""
entries.dialogueText: "Understandably so."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Very understandable.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very understandable."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She adjusted the pins over her brea..."
entries.dialogueText: She adjusted the pins over her breast pocket.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He pulled a tin of wax out of his p..."
entries.dialogueText: He pulled a tin of wax out of his pocket and dabbed some onto the ends of his moustache.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""And plan for what will happen once..."
entries.dialogueText: "And plan for what will happen once we land."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Just making sure you're ready for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just making sure you're ready for our meeting with your sister-in-law."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Just making sure you're ready for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just making sure you're ready for our meeting with your sister-in-law."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Rumburg's foreign ministers have h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg's foreign ministers have hinted that the Queen is quite dissatisfied with our recent actions."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""With all the foreign turmoil happe..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all the foreign turmoil happening lately, it is comforting to know that Queen Beatrice is still on our side."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I doubt it. I've done nothing but..."
entries.dialogueText: "I doubt it. I've done nothing but alienate Rumburg since my coronation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She had better be. I've been bendi..."
entries.dialogueText: "She had better be. I've been bending over backwards for Rumburg since my coronation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She's family. Family members suppo..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's family. Family members support each other, no matter what."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sure she wants to get Vina out..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure she wants to get Vina out of there as I do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This visit is just a courtesy. We'..."
entries.dialogueText: "This visit is just a courtesy. We're perfectly capable of defeating Pales on our own."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I wish I shared your optimism.""
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I shared your optimism."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As long as ATO doesn't get involve..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as ATO doesn't get involved."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I'm sure she appreciates that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure she appreciates that."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We all do.""
entries.dialogueText: "We all do."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Beatrice's only real family in Riz..."
entries.dialogueText: "Beatrice's only real family in Rizia is Vina. But she does seem to be fond of the Princess."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""You always have your family ties t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You always have your family ties to fall back on. If she still considers herself family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not surprised. I've done nothi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not surprised. I've done nothing but alienate Rumburg since my coronation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She had better be. I've been bendi..."
entries.dialogueText: "She had better be. I've been bending over backwards for Rumburg since my coronation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She's family. Family members suppo..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's family. Family members support each other, no matter what."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, I have no doubt that Her Exce..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I have no doubt that Her Excellency still harbors warm feelings towards you."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""You always have your family ties t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You always have your family ties to fall back on. Her Excellency was always fond of Princess Vina."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I'm sure Her Excellency appreciate..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure Her Excellency appreciates that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that so? What did I do?""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that so? What did I do?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I am sure Her Excellency is eager..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sure Her Excellency is eager to tell you in person."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whatever that's worth. Rumburg has..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever that's worth. Rumburg hasn't been looking great internationally."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It is still a most powerful nation..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is still a most powerful nation. And by far a more useful friend than enemy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you say so. I've been questioni..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you say so. I've been questioning the value of our so-called alliance."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""It's still a very powerful country..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's still a very powerful country. By far a better friend than enemy."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The plane's door slid open. An aide..."
entries.dialogueText: The plane's door slid open. An aide informed us that everything had been cleared for our arrival.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Thornbourgh Airport, one of the big..."
entries.dialogueText: Thornbourgh Airport, one of the biggest transportation hubs in Merkopa, had been completely emptied of passengers for our visit.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She abruptly turned and regarded Lu..."
entries.dialogueText: She abruptly turned and regarded Lucita, who was standing behind me.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Duchess Azaro. Your reputation pre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Duchess Azaro. Your reputation precedes you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She abruptly turned and regarded La..."
entries.dialogueText: She abruptly turned and regarded Laurento, who was standing behind me.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Mr. Esquibel. His Majesty is lucky..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Esquibel. His Majesty is lucky to have retained the services of a fine statesman like yourself."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The good fortune is all mine.""
entries.dialogueText: "The good fortune is all mine."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With a flourish, he knelt and kisse..."
entries.dialogueText: With a flourish, he knelt and kissed Beatrice's hand. She blushed slightly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita performed a graceful curtsy."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita performed a graceful curtsy.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""A pleasure to finally meet you, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "A pleasure to finally meet you, Your Excellency. I hope you've only heard good things."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Why, of course. A noblewoman *and*..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why, of course. A noblewoman *and* a decorated military officer? You're a credit to our sex."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes traveled from Lucita to my..."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes traveled from Lucita to myself and back. She smiled insincerely.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Why, yes. Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Why, yes. Of course."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Let's not delay. We have a full pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not delay. We have a full program of events planned at the Emerald Palace."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She cursorily introduced Lucita to..."
entries.dialogueText: She cursorily introduced Lucita to King Consort Boris and Prince Bradley. I exchanged greetings with the two men.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh. You remember King Consort Bori..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh. You remember King Consort Boris and Prince Bradley."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento and I exchanged cursory gr..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento and I exchanged cursory greetings with the two men.

entries.dialogueText: We got into the car and sat facing each other on leather banquettes. The engine thrummed to life, and we began moving.

entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Frankly, given the state of things..."
entries.dialogueText: "Frankly, given the state of things between our kingdoms, I ought to leave you high and dry."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Naturally, I would love to have a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Naturally, I would love to have a hand in the surrender of that self-styled Duke Reinhart."

entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Need I remind you of your kingdom'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Need I remind you of your kingdom's broken energy promises?"

entries.dialogueText: "What were you thinking when you took advantage of our embargo on Wehzek oil to begin importing it yourself?"

entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""But we share a common goal. The re..."
entries.dialogueText: "But we share a common goal. The rescue of dear Princess Vina from her Palesian captors."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""For the sake of my niece, I will f..."
entries.dialogueText: "For the sake of my niece, I will forgive any number of transgressions on Rizia's part."

entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Excellency. That means a lot to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Really? You care about Vina that much?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What transgressions?""
entries.dialogueText: "What transgressions?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Do you think I'm a monster, Your M..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think I'm a monster, Your Majesty? She is my flesh and blood."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am not doing this for you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am not doing this for you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She shot me an ominous glance."
entries.dialogueText: She shot me an ominous glance.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""We will get into that later. If we..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will get into that later. If we have time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you would not offer your aid if..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you would not offer your aid if Vina's life weren't on the line. How disappointing."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""There is a limit to Rumburg's gene..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is a limit to Rumburg's generosity. I feel Rizia has been testing it of late."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I should say so. I needn't remind..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should say so. I needn't remind you of the superiority of Rumburg's military technology."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita forced a smile."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita forced a smile.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She drew herself back."
entries.dialogueText: She drew herself back.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita smoothly cut in."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita smoothly cut in.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Of course our operations in Pales..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course our operations in Pales are fully concentrated on the rescue of Princess Vina. Any support you can offer will surely increase our chances of success."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The capture of the Aureus gas fiel..."
entries.dialogueText: "The capture of the Aureus gas field would, of course, be a lovely bonus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This war is not about resources. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "This war is not about resources. It's about our kingdom's sovereignty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You do know that Rumburg is no lon..."
entries.dialogueText: "You do know that Rumburg is no longer our only energy partner."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It would, wouldn't it? But let's n..."
entries.dialogueText: "It would, wouldn't it? But let's not get too far ahead of ourselves."

entries.dialogueText: "The capture of the gas field is less important to me than the eradication of Western influence."

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, yes. We will defend that sovereignty together."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "That as well. The members of ATO should mind their own nations."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Yes, yes. There is more than enoug..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, yes. There is more than enough gas in that field to share."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Agreed. We have a war to win first.""
entries.dialogueText: "Agreed. We have a war to win first."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita smoothly cut in."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita smoothly cut in.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Our troops in Pales are fully conc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our troops in Pales are fully concentrated on winning the war without harming the integrity of the gas field. Any support you can offer will surely increase their chances of success."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Actually, Your Excellency, the cap..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, Your Excellency, the capabilities of the Rizian military have grown by leaps and bounds since the beginning of King Romus' reign."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I cannot argue with that, Your Exc..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot argue with that, Your Excellency. Our homegrown military industry is in its infancy compared to yours."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""But yes, our industry is still in..."
entries.dialogueText: "But yes, our industry is still in its infancy compared to yours."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice nodded proudly."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice nodded proudly.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""We shall prepare a sizeable shipme..."
entries.dialogueText: "We shall prepare a sizeable shipment of our very finest equipment. KA-74s, grenades, body armor... all will be at your disposal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perfect. I cannot thank you enough.""
entries.dialogueText: "Perfect. I cannot thank you enough."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have a few more specialized requ..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a few more specialized requests."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's it?""
entries.dialogueText: "That's it?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It is the least I can do.""
entries.dialogueText: "It is the least I can do."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I expect you to use it responsibly.""
entries.dialogueText: "I expect you to use it responsibly."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And the safe and sound return of m..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the safe and sound return of my dear niece, needless to say."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Hmm. I thought you might.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. I thought you might."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""That is it.""
entries.dialogueText: "That is it."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""What else do you need to win the w..."
entries.dialogueText: "What else do you need to win the war?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We could use more tanks. Our men o..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could use more tanks. Our men on the ground are moving around unprotected."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Say, do your scientists happen to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Say, do your scientists happen to be developing nuclear weapons? I'd love one or two of those."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is there anything experimental you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is there anything experimental you're working on? Something the enemy won't expect at all?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We need trucks. All that equipment..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need trucks. All that equipment is no good if we can't transport it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She put a hand to her necklace."
entries.dialogueText: She put a hand to her necklace.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh, my. Wherever did you get that..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, my. Wherever did you get that idea?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A confidential glint appeared in he..."
entries.dialogueText: A confidential glint appeared in her eye.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Interesting that you ask.""
entries.dialogueText: "Interesting that you ask."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Our laboratories have been working..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our laboratories have been working on a powerful new nerve agent. A few milligrams are powerful enough to kill a rat from 50 meters away."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It has not yet been tested on huma..."
entries.dialogueText: "It has not yet been tested on humans. But we're happy to let Rizia do the honors."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, God. No, we don't want any par..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, God. No, we don't want any part in that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Palesians hardly qualify as hu..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Palesians hardly qualify as human. But yes, we'll take it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sounds extreme. But, well, these a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sounds extreme. But, well, these are extreme times."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am loathe to use chemical weapon..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am loathe to use chemical weapons, but a stockpile might come in handy in case of emergency."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita recoiled in horror. She shoo..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita recoiled in horror. She shook her head slightly.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Suit yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Suit yourself."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She folded her hands."
entries.dialogueText: She folded her hands.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Do you have other requests?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you have other requests?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Very wise of you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very wise of you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She folded her hands."
entries.dialogueText: She folded her hands.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Extreme times indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Extreme times indeed."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You'll have to let me know whether..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll have to let me know whether it works. We see its promise in expediting future conflicts."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita peered at her closely."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita peered at her closely.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Are you telling me that Rumburg is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you telling me that Rumburg is not currently engaged in any nuclear research programs?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Is this an interrogation, Duchess..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is this an interrogation, Duchess Azaro? I will warn you not to take Rumburg's largesse for granted."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Of course it should be reserved fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course it should be reserved for only the most dire of circumstances. Lord willing, you will not need it at all."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""That can most certainly be arrange..."
entries.dialogueText: "That can most certainly be arranged."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Now. Please let me know if you hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now. Please let me know if you have any serious requests."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw Lucita nod in approval."
entries.dialogueText: I saw Lucita nod in approval.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""A most reasonable request. Conside..."
entries.dialogueText: "A most reasonable request. Consider it granted."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""My dear, if you want more, all you..."
entries.dialogueText: "My dear, if you want more, all you have to do is ask."

entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I do have one rather unconventiona..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do have one rather unconventional suggestion."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You could sell us your Port of Mon..."
entries.dialogueText: "You could sell us your Port of Monqiz."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""His Majesty is absolutely right. G..."
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty is absolutely right. Granting any foreign country control over Monqiz would be a major security risk."

entries.dialogueText: "We'll sell you our largest port over my dead body."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sure, why not? I don't see the har..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure, why not? I don't see the harm in it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What? Your Majesty, Monqiz is our..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? Your Majesty, Monqiz is our most strategically vital shipping hub."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Granting your kingdom a foothold i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Granting your kingdom a foothold in the southern Antacean. I see."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Convenient for Rumburg. But a giga..."
entries.dialogueText: "Convenient for Rumburg. But a gigantic security risk for us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have some concerns about that pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have some concerns about that proposal. To put it mildly."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As you should, Your Majesty. We ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you should, Your Majesty. We can ill afford to lose another part of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Until you take Pales, that is.""
entries.dialogueText: "Until you take Pales, that is."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Look at how shabby the port has be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at how shabby the port has become. With our technology, we can get it into tip-top shape in an instant."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Your efforts to modernize the port..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your efforts to modernize the port have been admirable, but with our technology, we can maximize its efficiency even further."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""But Rumburg is not just any foreig..."
entries.dialogueText: "But Rumburg is not just any foreign country, are we?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Don't be so pessimistic, Your Grac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be so pessimistic, Your Grace. I foresee advantages for both of us."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You wouldn't be losing Monqiz. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "You wouldn't be losing Monqiz. You'd be sharing it."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As you're shipping us a sizeable a..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you're shipping us a sizeable amount of energy through Monqiz, it's only logical to give us a say in how that shipping is run."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And giving Rumburg a say in how sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "And giving Rumburg a say in how shipping is run would only be logical should you begin sending us gas from the Aureus field."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What you're saying makes sense. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "What you're saying makes sense. But I still have reservations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Such a cooperation would truly cem..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such a cooperation would truly cement the alliance between our monarchies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If we did this for you, we'd never..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we did this for you, we'd never owe you anything again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are trying to become less depen..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are trying to become less dependent on Rumburg. This will accomplish the opposite."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Less dependent on everything but o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Less dependent on everything but our military aid, you mean."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Let's not beat around the bush. Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not beat around the bush. You have come here to ask for help in the war against Pales."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are correct, Your Excellency...."
entries.dialogueText: "You are correct, Your Excellency. Will Rumburg come to our aid?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That'd be convenient for you, woul..."
entries.dialogueText: "That'd be convenient for you, wouldn't it? But no, Rizia is well on its way to defeating Pales on its own."

entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita nodded proudly in confirmati..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita nodded proudly in confirmation.

entries.dialogueText: "I do not doubt your capabilities, Your Grace. But I cannot rest easily until I have done everything I can to rescue dear Princess Vina from her Palesian captors."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Is that so? How marvelous.""
entries.dialogueText: "Is that so? How marvelous."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Really, there is no need.""
entries.dialogueText: "Really, there is no need."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "I must insist."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Your Excellency. Your affection for Vina is touching."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "She is a special young lady."

entries.dialogueText: "Then you truly have no need for military aid from us?"

entries.dialogueText: "And let's not forget that our dear Princess Vina is still a captive of the Palesians."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I cannot rest easily until I have..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot rest easily until I have done everything I can to secure her safe return."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "Is that so? How dreadful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well... maybe just in case.""
entries.dialogueText: "Well... maybe just in case."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I do not need Rumburg or anyone's help. The Lord has ordained that we shall win this fight."

entries.dialogueText: Lucita bit her lip.

entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I believe our success has less to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I believe our success has less to do with the Lord and more with the renewed strength of the Rizian military. But yes, we are doing well."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Simply put, we're screwed without..."
entries.dialogueText: "Simply put, we're screwed without you.

entries.dialogueText: Lucita bit her lip.

entries.dialogueText: "That's an exaggeration, Your Excellency. But we would appreciate any assistance we can get from Rumburg."

entries.dialogueText: Lucita winced.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro

entries.dialogueText: "That's unfortunately not an exaggeration, Your Excellency. We are failing on all fronts."

entries.dialogueText: "Oh, no. How dreadful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. Of course I will let you know..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. Of course I will let you know if the situation changes."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Beatrice smirked.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I thought so.""
entries.dialogueText: "I thought so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, fine. Perhaps we do require Rumburg's assistance after all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A temporary setback. I am certain..."
entries.dialogueText: "A temporary setback. I am certain we will recover."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "If you are absolutely certain, then I will not press the matter."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I pray that it will not.""
entries.dialogueText: "I pray that it will not."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She leaned back on the banquette."
entries.dialogueText: She leaned back on the banquette.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am sorry His Majesty diverted yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry His Majesty diverted your attention from the war to come see me, Duchess Azaro."

entries.dialogueText: "No apology needed. It has been my pleasure to accompany His Majesty here."

entries.dialogueText: "My attention is always on the war, Your Excellency. No matter where I am."

entries.dialogueText: A sour look appeared on Beatrice's face.

entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure it has..."

entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely not. I am a king of my word, and I stick to my agreements."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I will not. The heretic Golcondists do not deserve my mercy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have no further requests, Your E..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no further requests, Your Excellency. Thank you for everything."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""No trouble at all. Really.""
entries.dialogueText: "No trouble at all. Really."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As soon as we were in motion, Beatr..."
entries.dialogueText: As soon as we were in motion, Beatrice's cordial expression gave way to an icy stare.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your Majesty, what exactly is Rumb..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, what exactly is Rumburg's trouble with Sordland?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In case you haven't forgotten, our..."
entries.dialogueText: "In case you haven't forgotten, our investment in Sordish gas is benefiting both of our kingdoms."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not a fan of the Sords either...."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not a fan of the Sords either. Not after the trouble they've been giving you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I cannot break my agreement with W..."
entries.dialogueText: "I cannot break my agreement with Wiktor Smolak. The fate of Zille hangs in the balance."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Then you must decide. Zille or Pal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then you must decide. Zille or Pales?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are oppressing no one. We are m..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are oppressing no one. We are merely executing counterterrorism measures."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Do not fool yourself.""
entries.dialogueText: "Do not fool yourself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I did not realize Rumburg and the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not realize Rumburg and the BFF were that closely connected."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Not officially, of course. You wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not officially, of course. You will find no paper trail."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I know you yourself are at war. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you yourself are at war. But it was cruel to let the Prince of Vendonesam's pleas for aid go unanswered."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As if that weren't enough, you arr..."
entries.dialogueText: "As if that weren't enough, you arrested your own cousin and brought disgrace upon your royal house!"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""At this stage, Your Majesty, the q..."
entries.dialogueText: "At this stage, Your Majesty, the question isn't whether Rumburg will lend you aid. It's whether Rizia will remain a member of GRACE at all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She breathed in deeply."
entries.dialogueText: She breathed in deeply.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Before I can even think of lending..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before I can even think of lending you military aid, you must recommit to your relationship with Rumburg and GRACE."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't care about my standing wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't care about my standing with GRACE."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia is a founding member of GRAC..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia is a founding member of GRACE. You cannot kick us out so easily."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What can I do to get back in your..."
entries.dialogueText: "What can I do to get back in your good graces? Pun intended."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It is a simple majority vote, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a simple majority vote, Your Majesty. And when it comes to Rumburg versus Rizia, you know which side the other monarchies will take."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Well, you should. Without the supp..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, you should. Without the support of other monarchies, Rizia will fall even if it wins Pales."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am glad you asked.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am glad you asked."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What can I do to get back in your..."
entries.dialogueText: "What can I do to get back in your good graces? No pun intended."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please, Beatrice. I'll do anything.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please, Beatrice. I'll do anything."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""No need to kiss my feet, dear. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need to kiss my feet, dear. We are still family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are overreacting. We've always..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are overreacting. We've always been on Rumburg's side."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I will be the judge of that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will be the judge of that."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I propose a deal. Our finest milit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I propose a deal. Our finest military aid package in exchange for the sale of your Port of Monqiz to Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita's mouth dropped open."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita's mouth dropped open.

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""His Majesty is absolutely right. G..."
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty is absolutely right. Granting any foreign country control over Monqiz would be a major security risk."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll sell you our largest port ov..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll sell you our largest port over my dead body."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sure, why not? I don't see the har..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure, why not? I don't see the harm in it."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""What? Your Majesty, Monqiz is our..."
entries.dialogueText: "What? Your Majesty, Monqiz is our most strategically vital shipping hub."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Granting your kingdom a foothold i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Granting your kingdom a foothold in the southern Antacean. I see."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""Convenient for Rumburg. But a giga..."
entries.dialogueText: "Convenient for Rumburg. But a gigantic security risk for us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have some concerns about that pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have some concerns about that proposal. To put it mildly."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""As you should, Your Majesty. We ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you should, Your Majesty. We can ill afford to lose another part of Rizia."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Until you take Pales, that is.""
entries.dialogueText: "Until you take Pales, that is."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Look at how shabby the port has be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at how shabby the port has become. With our technology, we can get it into marvelous shape in an instant."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Your efforts to modernize the port..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your efforts to modernize the port have been admirable, but with our technology, we can maximize its efficiency even further."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""But Rumburg is not just any foreig..."
entries.dialogueText: "But Rumburg is not just any foreign country, are we?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Don't be so pessimistic, Your Grac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be so pessimistic, Your Grace. I foresee advantages for both of us."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You wouldn't be losing Monqiz. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "You wouldn't be losing Monqiz. You'd be sharing it."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As you're shipping us a sizeable a..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you're shipping us a sizeable amount of energy through Monqiz, it's only logical to give us a say in how that shipping is run."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And giving Rumburg a say in how sh..."
entries.dialogueText: "And giving Rumburg a say in how shipping is run would only be logical should you begin sending us gas from the Aureus field."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can see the sense of what you're..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can see the sense of what you're saying. But I still think the disadvantages outweigh the benefits."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Such a cooperation would truly cem..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such a cooperation would truly cement the alliance between our monarchies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If we did this for you, we'd never..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we did this for you, we'd never owe you anything again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are trying to become less depen..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are trying to become less dependent on Rumburg. This will accomplish the opposite."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Less dependent on everything but o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Less dependent on everything but our military aid, you mean."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Indeed it would.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed it would."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""No need for hyperbole. But it woul..."
entries.dialogueText: "No need for hyperbole. But it would be quite the grand gesture."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Think what you will. You know I am..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think what you will. You know I am right."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""We do not need to resort to desper..."
entries.dialogueText: "We do not need to resort to desperate measures to win the war, Your Majesty. We should not relinquish control of a critical asset for the sake of some artillery."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I admit winning the war may requir..."
entries.dialogueText: "I admit winning the war may require drastic measures. But relinquishing control of this critical asset will leave us vulnerable in the future."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My war councilor is right. I will..."
entries.dialogueText: "My war councilor is right. I will not sell the Port of Monqiz to Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know it's a risk, but victory wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know it's a risk, but victory will be worth it. Rumburg may purchase the port, Your Excellency."
entries.menuText: "I know it's a risk, but victory will be worth it. Rumburg may purchase the port, Your Excellency." [+2 Budget, +2 Budget Per Turn]

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice clasped her hands together..."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice clasped her hands together.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Brilliant. This will be our kingdo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Brilliant. This will be our kingdoms' most fruitful collaboration yet."

Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita tried hard to hide her disma..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita tried hard to hide her dismay.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice sighed."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice sighed.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You are on your own in this war, t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are on your own in this war, then."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I sincerely hope your weaponry liv..."
entries.dialogueText: "I sincerely hope your weaponry lives up to its reputation."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Of course it will, Your Grace. I w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course it will, Your Grace. I will arrange for a sizeable shipment of equipment to be sent to Rizia posthaste."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""That should be enough to mend our..."
entries.dialogueText: "That should be enough to mend our fences, don't you think?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes. it's enough. It's *more* than..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. it's enough. It's *more* than enough."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not so fast. I think I deserve a l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not so fast. I think I deserve a little more than that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I appreciate your generosity. Howe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your generosity. However, our military needs go beyond basic equipment."

entries.speaker: Lucita Azaro
entries.title: Lucita Azaro: ""I respectfully disagree. For a con..."
entries.dialogueText: "I respectfully disagree. For a concession of this magnitude, Rizia deserves much more."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You drive a hard bargain, Your Gra..."
entries.dialogueText: "You drive a hard bargain, Your Grace."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""What else do you want?""
entries.dialogueText: "What else do you want?"

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
entries.title: Jump to: [Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Here's the rub, though.""]

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You will continue to receive the s..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will continue to receive the support of GRACE. That is enough of a reward."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You drive a hard bargain, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "You drive a hard bargain, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I do still respect you, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do still respect you, Your Majesty. But know that you are on thin ice. With me, and with the other monarchs of this world."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice smiled warmly."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice smiled warmly.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Let's not beat around the bush, Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's not beat around the bush, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""If your goal is to lose Rumburg's..."
entries.dialogueText: "If your goal is to lose Rumburg's support and get yourself booted out of GRACE, you've been doing a bang-up job of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Mistakes were made. Can you find i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mistakes were made. Can you find it in your heart to forgive me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rumburg helped carry Rizia through..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg helped carry Rizia through the tough years after the uprising. I am forever grateful for that. But I have begun to rethink our partnership."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're bluffing, Your Excellency...."
entries.dialogueText: "You're bluffing, Your Excellency. You need Rizia as much as we need you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Goal? I've been flying by the seat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Goal? I've been flying by the seat of my trousers since my father died."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I don't believe you're joking.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't believe you're joking."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Come, now. You know that is not th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come, now. You know that is not the case."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Rethink? You are turning your back..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rethink? You are turning your back on Rumburg completely."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I wish I could believe they were m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I could believe they were merely mistakes."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It seems you did not take my advic..."
entries.dialogueText: "It seems you did not take my advice regarding the treatment of Dastnurists in your country. I am warning you, Rumburg does not want a flood of religious asylum seekers at our borders."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You ceded control of your kingdom'..."
entries.dialogueText: "You ceded control of your kingdom's parliament to a bunch of scheming reformists..."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Need I remind you of your broken e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Need I remind you of your broken energy promises to us?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""What did you expect would happen w..."
entries.dialogueText: "What did you expect would happen when you undermined Rumburg by helping Wehlen in its senseless campaign against the Bluds?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""What were you thinking when you to..."
entries.dialogueText: "What were you thinking when you took advantage of our embargo on Wehzek oil to begin importing it yourself?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Leaving the Prince of Vendonesam h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Leaving the Prince of Vendonesam high and dry in his time of need... nobody truly invested in the future of monarchies would be so cruel."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As if that weren't enough, you arr..."
entries.dialogueText: "As if that weren't enough, you arrested your own cousin and brought disgrace upon your royal house!"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You seem not to have taken my prev..."
entries.dialogueText: "You seem not to have taken my previous advice about Dastnurity. Believe me when I say Rumburg does not need hordes of Rizian Dastnurist asylum seekers streaming past our borders."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You ceded control of your kingdom'..."
entries.dialogueText: "You ceded control of your kingdom's parliament to a bunch of scheming reformists..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She breathed in deeply."
entries.dialogueText: She breathed in deeply.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I have to ask. Do our blood ties m..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have to ask. Do our blood ties mean nothing to you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Lena meant everything to me. But w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lena meant everything to me. But with her gone, I don't see why I should stay connected to Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your sister and I were forced into..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your sister and I were forced into an unhappy marriage. What you call blood ties, I call shackles."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't be ridiculous, Beatrice. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be ridiculous, Beatrice. You're like the sister I never had. And I know how fond you are of Vina."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will always be family, even if..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will always be family, even if the alliance between our kingdoms is broken."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Please don't cut us off, Your Exce..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please don't cut us off, Your Excellency. Innocent citizens will suffer."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento tentatively spoke up."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento tentatively spoke up.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Fair points, Your Excellency. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fair points, Your Excellency. But Rizia is a founding member of GRACE. Threatening to drive us out entirely is--"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am not addressing you, Mr. Esqui..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not addressing you, Mr. Esquibel. I am speaking to my brother-in-law."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her eyes momentarily softened."
entries.dialogueText: Her eyes momentarily softened.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice's nostrils flared."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice's nostrils flared.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""So you don't see the economic bene..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you don't see the economic benefits of staying in GRACE?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Or of our joint investment in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or of our joint investment in the Sordish gas industry?"
