entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And what of our ability to help yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "And what of our ability to help you pry Zille from the claws of the Wehzeks?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice's nostrils flared."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice's nostrils flared.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Be that as it may... you don't see..."
entries.dialogueText: "Be that as it may... you don't see the economic benefits of staying in GRACE?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Besides which... surely you see th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Besides which... surely you see the economic benefits of staying in GRACE?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Your citizens are suffering as it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your citizens are suffering as it is. We've played no part in that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Her nostrils flared."
entries.dialogueText: Her nostrils flared.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Had there been no alliance, we wou..."
entries.dialogueText: "Had there been no alliance, we would not be family."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Hmm. I am glad you see the wisdom..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. I am glad you see the wisdom of staying in GRACE."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""But I am glad you see the wisdom o..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I am glad you see the wisdom of staying in GRACE."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""There is one thing you can do that..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is one thing you can do that will dramatically improve your standing with us. I warn you it is rather unorthodox."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have other partnerships now. Ru..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have other partnerships now. Rumburg simply isn't as important to us anymore."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If there's something you want from..."
entries.dialogueText: "If there's something you want from Rizia, please just spit it out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll bite. How can you help us?""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll bite. How can you help us?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We accepted your help already. Not..."
entries.dialogueText: "We accepted your help already. Nothing came of it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We didn't need your help before. A..."
entries.dialogueText: "We didn't need your help before. And we don't need it now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So what will it take to stay in yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "So what will it take to stay in your good graces? No pun intended."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So what will it take to stay in yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "So what will it take to stay in your good graces? Pun intended."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rumburg has gone around making ene..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg has gone around making enemies with half of Merkopa. It does us no good to stay connected to you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She half-smiled."
entries.dialogueText: She half-smiled.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Well, since you've mentioned it......"
entries.dialogueText: "Well, since you've mentioned it... I do have one suggestion. I warn you it is rather unorthodox."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You could sell us your Port of Mon..."
entries.dialogueText: "You could sell us your Port of Monqiz."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""His Majesty is being hyperbolic. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "His Majesty is being hyperbolic. But you must understand the risks inherent in such a sale, Your Excellency."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We'll sell you our largest port ov..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll sell you our largest port over my dead body."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Sure, why not? I don't see the har..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure, why not? I don't see the harm in it."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Your goodwill is beyond measure, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your goodwill is beyond measure, Your Majesty. But you may want to consider the risks inherent in such a sele."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Granting your kingdom a foothold i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Granting your kingdom a foothold in the southern Antacean. I see."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, very geopolitically convenien..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, very geopolitically convenient for Rumburg. But I don't see commensurate benefits for Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have some concerns about that pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have some concerns about that proposal. To put it mildly."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""As you should, Your Majesty. Givin..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you should, Your Majesty. Giving away another part of Rizia before Zille is returned would be most unwise."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Risks? I see nothing but rewards f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Risks? I see nothing but rewards for both of us."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Look at how shabby the port has be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look at how shabby the port has become. With our technology, we can get it into tip-top shape in an instant."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Your efforts to modernize the port..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your efforts to modernize the port have been admirable, but with our technology, we can maximize its efficiency even further."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Anything worth doing in life invol..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anything worth doing in life involves risk, Mr. Esquibel."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Don't be so pessimistic, Your Grac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be so pessimistic, Your Grace. I foresee advantages for both of us."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You wouldn't be giving Monqiz away..."
entries.dialogueText: "You wouldn't be giving Monqiz away. You'd be sharing it."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As you're shipping us a sizeable a..."
entries.dialogueText: "As you're shipping us a sizeable amount of energy through Monqiz, it's only logical to give us a say in how that shipping is run."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And given the volume of trade betw..."
entries.dialogueText: "And given the volume of trade between Rizia and Rumburg, it does make sense to give us a say in how shipping is run."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That may be true. But I still have..."
entries.dialogueText: "That may be true. But I still have reservations."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Such a cooperation would truly cem..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such a cooperation would truly cement the alliance between our monarchies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If we did this for you, we'd never..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we did this for you, we'd never owe you anything again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are trying to become less depen..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are trying to become less dependent on Rumburg. This will accomplish the opposite."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Indeed it would.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed it would."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As would any king. Perhaps Mr. Esq..."
entries.dialogueText: "As would any king. Perhaps Mr. Esquibel can help you see past them."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I agree it would be quite the gran..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree it would be quite the grand gesture."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""We have certain contacts within We..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have certain contacts within Wehlen who could stir up trouble in Zille. Possibly enough to overthrow the government."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I'm referring to a different kind..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm referring to a different kind of help."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento's eyes grew wide."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento's eyes grew wide.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I assume you're referring to the B..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assume you're referring to the Bludish Freedom Front. But how could they help Rizia. And why?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""That is for us to discuss later. A..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is for us to discuss later. After you have recommitted to your partnership with Rumburg and GRACE."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right, Your Excellency. How do..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right, Your Excellency. How do I recommit?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""What His Majesty means to say is--""
entries.dialogueText: "What His Majesty means to say is--"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I know perfectly well what His Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know perfectly well what His Majesty means to say."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Driver! Stop this car at once.""
entries.dialogueText: "Driver! Stop this car at once."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice cut him off coldly."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice cut him off coldly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our limousine screeched to a halt i..."
entries.dialogueText: Our limousine screeched to a halt in the middle of the empty freeway. I heard the squeal of tires as the rest of the motorcade did the same.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""If you see no more value in our na..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you see no more value in our nations' partnership, then I see no more value in riding with you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The driver exited the vehicle and o..."
entries.dialogueText: The driver exited the vehicle and opened the passenger door for her.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""We shall go through the diplomatic..."
entries.dialogueText: "We shall go through the diplomatic formalities at the palace and put you on the first plane back tomorrow. Good day."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Wait. I want to stay in GRACE. Let..."
entries.dialogueText: "Wait. I want to stay in GRACE. Let's talk."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good day, Your Excellency.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good day, Your Excellency."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't be such a drama queen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be such a drama queen."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I didn't mean to offend you.""
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't mean to offend you."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I shall speak to our partners in G..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shall speak to our partners in GRACE posthaste. They're not going to be pleased with your attitude."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gathered her gown and left the..."
entries.dialogueText: She gathered her gown and left the car. I heard a door open and close as she got into the limousine carrying the rest of her family.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh?""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She motioned to the driver to shut..."
entries.dialogueText: She motioned to the driver to shut the door again. He returned to the car and we began moving again.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Forget it. That sounds like a spec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forget it. That sounds like a spectacularly bad idea."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You want me to forget it? Fine. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "You want me to forget it? Fine. I will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't know about Zille, but I do..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know about Zille, but I do care about our economic partnership. How do we restore that?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Don't think of it as dependence. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't think of it as dependence. Think of it as venturing into the future together."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento shook his head slowly."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento shook his head slowly.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I am all for diplomacy, Your Majes..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am all for diplomacy, Your Majesty, but I urge you not to relinquish control over such a critical asset. Especially not while things are going so well with our neighbors."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We have not outgrown the need for..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have not outgrown the need for GRACE's protection. But I would still think twice before relinquishing control over such a critical asset."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Were your security councilor here..."
entries.dialogueText: "Were your security councilor here today, she would tell you the same thing. Using stronger language."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Were any members of House Azaro he..."
entries.dialogueText: "Were any members of House Azaro here today, they would tell you the same thing. Using stronger language."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree with you -- and with House..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree with you -- and with House Azaro. Your Excellency, there is no way I can sell the port."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I may have been exaggerating befor..."
entries.dialogueText: "I may have been exaggerating before. Rizia is not in such dire straits with Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento breathed a sigh of relief."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento breathed a sigh of relief.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's it? Of course I welcome the..."

entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. Is that how you help us get Zille back, then?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""If you wish.""

entries.dialogueText: "As loathe as I am to suggest violence as a solution to the Zille conundrum...  an internal resistance effort from the BFF could work in perfect concert with the Derdian mercenaries already present in the region."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I am still loathe to suggest viole..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am still loathe to suggest violence as a solution to the Zille conundrum. But in the absence of an agreement with President Smolak, an internal resistance might be our last hope."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I am loathe to suggest violence as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am loathe to suggest violence as a solution to the Zille conundrum. Especially since Wehlen may yet return the region through diplomatic means."

entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""They are a persecuted minority fig..."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "The BFF would be active in Zille sooner or later, anyway. We'd just be giving them a nudge."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The BFF have their own fight going..."
entries.dialogueText: "The BFF have their own fight going on. I don't want to interfere with it one way or another."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If we funded the BFF and Smolak fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we funded the BFF and Smolak found out about it, he'd have an excuse to hold on to Zille forever."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Why do I get the feeling you're tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why do I get the feeling you're trying to use both Rizia and the BFF toward your own ends, Your Excellency?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Don't be so cynical. I am giving y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be so cynical. I am giving you a final chance to prove that your interests still align with ours."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And who would tell him? Do you run..."
entries.dialogueText: "And who would tell him? Do you run that leaky of a ship, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Exactly.""
entries.dialogueText: "Exactly."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""That makes sense. But a monetary c..."
entries.dialogueText: "That makes sense. But a monetary contribution towards their struggle would nonetheless be greatly appreciated."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am giving you a final chance to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am giving you a final chance to prove that your interests align with ours. You may take it or leave it."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston

entries.dialogueText: "What a shame."

entries.dialogueText: "Up to this point, we have been aiding the Bluds' liberation efforts in the north of Wehlen. But I see no reason why their struggle can't be directed southward as well."

entries.dialogueText: "If I may, Your Excellency... Zille has nothing to do with the former Greater Bludia region. Why would the BFF get involved there?"

entries.dialogueText: "You have shown yourself to be no great friend to Wiktor Smolak. Besides which..."

entries.dialogueText: "Any action that destabilizes the Smolak regime will help the Bludish cause, no matter where it is carried out."

entries.dialogueText: "Oh, dear."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Very much so.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very much so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You should consider the same, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should consider the same, Your Excellency. Your secularization reforms will lead Rumburg to ruin."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It is not too late for you to embr..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is not too late for you to embrace Wruhecism either, Beatrice. Your sister was so happy after she saw the light."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""My sister despised your silly reli..."
entries.dialogueText: "My sister despised your silly religion almost as much as she despised you."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""My sister was happy with you. Wruh..."
entries.dialogueText: "My sister was happy with you. Wruhecism had nothing to do with it."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I... I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "I... I see."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The King does not wish to support..."
entries.dialogueText: "The King does not wish to support the Bludish Freedom Front, Your Excellency. Perhaps it's best to leave it at that."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As valuable as religion is to me p..."
entries.dialogueText: "As valuable as religion is to me personally, it must be separated from the state if my nation is to be taken seriously. I'm surprised Mr. Esquibel hasn't told you the same."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento grew indignant."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento grew indignant.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Rizia's religious governance is be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's religious governance is between the King and our Grand Wiseman. I wouldn't presume to have a say in such matters."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento's face flushed."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento's face flushed.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The King does not wish to support..."
entries.dialogueText: "The King does not wish to support the Bludish Freedom Front. No need to bring personal grievances into this conversation."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The King does not wish to support..."
entries.dialogueText: "The King does not wish to support the Bludish Freedom Front. Perhaps it's best to leave it at that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Once we were in motion, Beatrice sm..."
entries.dialogueText: Once we were in motion, Beatrice smiled at the two of us.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Well. Look at us. Still allies aft..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well. Look at us. Still allies after all these years."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""My energy ministers tell me that o..."
entries.dialogueText: "My energy ministers tell me that our deal is going swimmingly."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The Rumburgian expatriate communit..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Rumburgian expatriate community couldn't be happier with Rizia's recent religious reforms."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Your business-friendly policies ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your business-friendly policies have helped both of our nations greatly."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Then I suppose I have Mr. Esquibel..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then I suppose I have Mr. Esquibel to thank for Rizia's skillful de-escalation of the Pales situation."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""You are too kind, Your Excellency.""
entries.dialogueText: "You are too kind, Your Excellency."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But it was His Majesty who ferrete..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it was His Majesty who ferreted out the traitor in our midst."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But it was His Majesty's quick thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it was His Majesty's quick thinking that helped us avoid an armed conflict."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Ah, yes. What an unfortunate turn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, yes. What an unfortunate turn of events."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I had hoped to meet this Duchess A..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had hoped to meet this Duchess Azaro someday. It's rare to see a noblewoman who's also a capable military officer."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: She turned to me.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Too good to be true, as it turned..."
entries.dialogueText: "Too good to be true, as it turned out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Her father is just as capable, if..."
entries.dialogueText: "Her father is just as capable, if not more so."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She can't be that capable if she l..."
entries.dialogueText: "She can't be that capable if she let herself get found out."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: She turned to me.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""All that potential, wasted on warm..."
entries.dialogueText: "All that potential, wasted on warmongering."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As long as his warmongering days a..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as his warmongering days are over."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Ha. I cannot argue with that.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ha. I cannot argue with that."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Well done. And gaining access to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well done. And gaining access to the Aureus gas field at the same time -- what a feat."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Well done. Though it's a pity you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well done. Though it's a pity you lost access to the Aureus gas field after all that."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""In any event, well done. And manag..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any event, well done. And managing to keep your access to the Aureus field -- what a feat."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""In any event, well done. Though it..."
entries.dialogueText: "In any event, well done. Though it's a pity you lost access to the Aureus field."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Of course I'm pleased that you man..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course I'm pleased that you managed to gain access to the Aureus field while avoiding conflict with Pales."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I admit I was somewhat disappointe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I admit I was somewhat disappointed when Rizia lost access to the Aureus gas field."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We still have our energy partnersh..."
entries.dialogueText: "We still have our energy partnership with Sordland to fall back on."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Hmph. Yes. Sordland...""
entries.dialogueText: "Hmph. Yes. Sordland..."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I know it's not smooth sailing for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know it's not smooth sailing for any of us monarchies. But I trust you know what you're doing."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""The recent turmoil in Iza gave me..."
entries.dialogueText: "The recent turmoil in Iza gave me pause. But I trust you know what you're doing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Not at all. I've been flying by th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not at all. I've been flying by the seat of my trousers since Father died."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whenever the path before me is unc..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whenever the path before me is unclear, I ask the Lord to show me the way."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I see. Rather antiquated, but if i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see. Rather antiquated, but if it works..."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You could have fooled me.""
entries.dialogueText: "You could have fooled me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Iza is totally under control. Just..."
entries.dialogueText: "Iza is totally under control. Just had to take care of a few unsavory elements."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Oh, I do. But my vision for a tran..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, I do. But my vision for a transformed Rizia is far from complete."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Such as your own cousin... Well. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such as your own cousin... Well. It did seem like he deserved it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As long as we have Rumburg's conti..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as we have Rumburg's continued support, we shall not falter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I do. It won't be long before our..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do. It won't be long before our Golden Kingdom is restored once more."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You will. Fear not.""
entries.dialogueText: "You will. Fear not."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I suppose I have the Lord to thank..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose I have the Lord to thank for Rizia's skillful de-escalation of the Pales situation. Or was that Mr. Esquibel?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Don't change too much too swiftly...."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't change too much too swiftly. You have many years left to reign."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I am sure it will be. You have man..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sure it will be. You have many years left to reign."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I must compliment you on your skil..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must compliment you on your skillful de-escalation of the Pales situation. Unless, of course, that was Mr. Esquibel?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Between that and our energy partne..."
entries.dialogueText: "Between that and our energy partnership with Sordland, we will be able to continue our gas trade with Rumburg for years to come."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, as long as relations with Pal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, as long as relations with Pales stay friendly, we'll have the means to fulfill our energy commitments for years to come."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Excellent. We wouldn't want to hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent. We wouldn't want to have to go begging to Sordland, now, would we?"

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We have other energy sources to fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have other energy sources to fall back on. Or so Ms. Werner tells us."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our car began moving again. Laurent..."
entries.dialogueText: Our car began moving again. Laurento and I looked at each other.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good riddance.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good riddance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Was it something I said?""
entries.dialogueText: "Was it something I said?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps I could've handled that mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps I could've handled that more diplomatically."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I'm not going to lie. It will be a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not going to lie. It will be a real blow to Rizia if Rumburg cuts us off."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento smiled mischievously."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento smiled mischievously.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""The prospect of Rumburg cutting us..."
entries.dialogueText: "The prospect of Rumburg cutting us off would've struck fear into your father's heart. But you're made of stronger stuff."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento shifted in his seat uneasi..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento shifted in his seat uneasily.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We'll lose some trade income. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll lose some trade income. But if we continue strengthening our connections with our neighbors, we can afford to break our alliance."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""We're not in good standing with an..."
entries.dialogueText: "We're not in good standing with any of our neighbors. And to lose the support of our most powerful ally..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not worry. God will provide for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not worry. God will provide for us, as He always has."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Message received. Once we reach th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Message received. Once we reach the palace, I'll get to groveling."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rumburg was never our ally. More l..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rumburg was never our ally. More like our suzerain."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""A strong word.""
entries.dialogueText: "A strong word."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Beatrice will never completely cut..."
entries.dialogueText: "Beatrice will never completely cut us off. Not if she still wants to see Vina."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I will try to have faith, Your Maj..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will try to have faith, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It may be too late. The Queen is v..."
entries.dialogueText: "It may be too late. The Queen is very good at holding grudges."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've seen how Rumburg has been a..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've seen how Rumburg has been acting with Sordland. We need to get away from them before they make us look bad."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I do hope they're stable. I wouldn..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do hope they're stable. I wouldn't want to have to go begging to Sordland in the case of an energy crisis."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I have not yet broached the subjec..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have not yet broached the subject of Zille."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We rode on. I looked out the window..."
entries.dialogueText: We rode on. I looked out the window at a completely empty freeway.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""If Vina keeps associating with ant..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Vina keeps associating with anti-monarchists, her aunt may not want to see her."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Some things are stronger than fami..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some things are stronger than familial love, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""You're absolutely right. If only w..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're absolutely right. If only we could substitute GRACE with our own regional trade pact..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We may soon be too democratic for..."
entries.dialogueText: "We may soon be too democratic for GRACE, anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The other monarchies in GRACE are..."
entries.dialogueText: "The other monarchies in GRACE are too weak, anyway."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""But not for our neighbors. If only..."
entries.dialogueText: "But not for our neighbors. If only we could substitute GRACE with our own regional trade pact..."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""It is a very unbalanced organizati..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is a very unbalanced organization, isn't it? If only we could substitute GRACE with our own regional trade pact..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We turned off the freeway. The mass..."
entries.dialogueText: We turned off the freeway. The massive green domes of the Emerald Palace loomed in the distance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We were in for an awkward stay. I c..."
entries.dialogueText: We were in for an awkward stay. I could hardly wait to return home.

entries.dialogueText: None of us spoke as we turned off the freeway. The massive green domes of the Emerald Palace loomed in the distance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento smiled, but I could still..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento smiled, but I could still see concern around the corners of his eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope you make it worth our while..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you make it worth our while, Your Excellency."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I always do, don't I?""
entries.dialogueText: "I always do, don't I?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. Now let's talk about ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. Now let's talk about how you can help us win Zille back."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice sat upright."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice sat upright.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh, yes! How could I forget?""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, yes! How could I forget?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I didn't just make a terrible mist..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't just make a terrible mistake, did I?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh, no, no. Not at all.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, no, no. Not at all."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Remember, Your Majesty. Without Ru..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember, Your Majesty. Without Rumburg, the Golden Kingdom would turn to dust."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We turned off the freeway. The mass..."
entries.dialogueText: We turned off the freeway. The massive green domes of the Emerald Palace loomed in the distance.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We finished the journey in comforta..."
entries.dialogueText: We finished the journey in comfortable silence. There was still a long visit ahead of us.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What is there to broach? I didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "What is there to broach? I didn't need Rumburg's help with Zille before, and I don't need it now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Right. Your oil embargo helped us..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right. Your oil embargo helped us get a very favorable deal with Wehlen. I thank you for it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Right. It's unfortunate that we we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Right. It's unfortunate that we were unable to come to an agreement with Wehlen, despite the pressure from your oil embargo."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We should be getting the region ba..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should be getting the region back soon. Assuming we stick to the terms of my agreement with Wiktor Smolak."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have resistance forces in place..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have resistance forces in place there, but I'm worried they won't be enough."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Are you sure? Because I have anoth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you sure? Because I have another opportunity for you."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Indeed. But I have another opportu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. But I have another opportunity for you."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""In case that deal doesn't work out..."
entries.dialogueText: "In case that deal doesn't work out... I have another opportunity for you."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""That's music to my ears.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's music to my ears."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Now. Is anything else on your mind?""
entries.dialogueText: "Now. Is anything else on your mind?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We are a founding member of GRACE...."
entries.dialogueText: "We are a founding member of GRACE. The others would never vote us out."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But we're still family, right?""
entries.dialogueText: "But we're still family, right?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It's a dangerous road you are trav..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a dangerous road you are traveling, Your Majesty. Rumburg cannot accompany you on it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice shook her head sadly."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice shook her head sadly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia has other allies now. We don..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has other allies now. We don't need you. Isn't that true, Mr. Esquibel?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I hope that our kingdoms can still..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope that our kingdoms can still maintain a civil relationship."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""That is up to you, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "That is up to you, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Well, yes, we are in the process o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, yes, we are in the process of forming closer bonds with our neighbors. Though we still lack an international economic pact that is equivalent to GRACE."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento swallowed."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento swallowed.

entries.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""Yes, Your Majesty. Quite right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Your Majesty. Quite right."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice half-smiled."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice half-smiled.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As long as my niece remains heir t..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as my niece remains heir to the Rizian throne... then yes. We are still family."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""We shall see about that.""
entries.dialogueText: "We shall see about that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're bluffing. Rumburg still nee..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're bluffing. Rumburg still needs us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Cut us off if you wish. We have ot..."
entries.dialogueText: "Cut us off if you wish. We have other partnerships now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The age of monarchies is long past..."
entries.dialogueText: "The age of monarchies is long past, anyway. It is time for Rizia to evolve."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Good luck doing so while mired in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck doing so while mired in war."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I still treasure our familial bond..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still treasure our familial bond, Your Excellency. I hope you do as well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She gave me a guarded look."
entries.dialogueText: She gave me a guarded look.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As long as my niece is still heir..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as my niece is still heir to the Rizian throne, then yes, we are still family."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It makes no difference, Your Excel..."
entries.dialogueText: "It makes no difference, Your Excellency. God is with us."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""We shall see who needs whom more.""
entries.dialogueText: "We shall see who needs whom more."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me with a mixture of..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me with a mixture of fear and pity.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Then may He protect your troops.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then may He protect your troops."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita gave me a look of warning. B..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita gave me a look of warning. Beatrice instantly clocked it.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Hmm. May your new partners protect..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. May your new partners protect your troops, then."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita gave a tight nod of confirma..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita gave a tight nod of confirmation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "None of us spoke as we turned off t..."
entries.dialogueText: None of us spoke as we turned off the freeway. The massive green domes of the Emerald Palace loomed in the distance.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Only what your talented chefs will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only what your talented chefs will be serving us for supper tonight."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What happens if your tensions with..."
entries.dialogueText: "What happens if your tensions with Sordland escalate? Do you expect Rizia to fight for you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How important is it to you that Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "How important is it to you that Rizia stay a member of GRACE?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If I told you I had moved on from..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I told you I had moved on from Lena, would it bother you?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita shifted in her seat nervousl..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita shifted in her seat nervously. The Queen's eyes darted between the two of us again.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Finally, Beatrice laughed lightly."
entries.dialogueText: Finally, Beatrice laughed lightly.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It's been over 10 years, my dear...."
entries.dialogueText: "It's been over 10 years, my dear. I would be concerned if you hadn't moved on."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both Lucita and the Queen gave me c..."
entries.dialogueText: Both Lucita and the Queen gave me curious looks.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The Queen fixed me with a long star..."
entries.dialogueText: The Queen fixed me with a long stare.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Both Laurento and the Queen gave me..."
entries.dialogueText: Both Laurento and the Queen gave me curious looks.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Fret not. As long as my niece is s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fret not. As long as my niece is still heir apparent to the Rizian throne, you will always be family in my eyes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice laughed lightly."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice laughed lightly.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""That's the spirit. Have you ever h..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's the spirit. Have you ever had caviar from the Tranquil Sea? I'll be so bold as to declare that it gives the Lespians a run for their money."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She frowned."
entries.dialogueText: She frowned.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""My dear... no nation is an island.""
entries.dialogueText: "My dear... no nation is an island."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""You may be drawing closer to your..."
entries.dialogueText: "You may be drawing closer to your neighbors, but do they understand the unique pressures a monarch is under? Will they offer you economic protection in times of hardship?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""We are facing isolation from our n..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are facing isolation from our neighbors and pressure from an increasingly democratized world. We need each other more than ever."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She raised an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: She raised an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""First off, there will be no escala..."
entries.dialogueText: "First off, there will be no escalation. Not if President Rayne knows what is good for him."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Second, Rumburg has enough reservi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Second, Rumburg has enough reservists to fight for a century if we need to. Calling in our distant neighbors would be a waste of ship fuel."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Out of the corner of my eye, I saw..."
entries.dialogueText: Out of the corner of my eye, I saw Lucita nod in agreement.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Out of the corner of my eye, I saw..."
entries.dialogueText: Out of the corner of my eye, I saw Laurento nod in agreement.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""But of course, I would expect you..."
entries.dialogueText: "But of course, I would expect you to support the cause. As I am doing for you."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""But of course, I would expect you..."
entries.dialogueText: "But of course, I would expect you to support the cause in whatever way you could."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Should that day ever come, Rizia w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should that day ever come, Rizia will be there for you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Getting caught between trading par..."
entries.dialogueText: "Getting caught between trading partners would be most uncomfortable. But you know where my allegiances lie."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I feel the same way about the Sord..."
entries.dialogueText: "I feel the same way about the Sords as you do. You do not have to doubt my allegiance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's very good to know.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's very good to know."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Yes. I do.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. I do."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I don't doubt it one bit.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't doubt it one bit."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I do not doubt it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I do not doubt it."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""No nation is an island, my dear. E..."
entries.dialogueText: "No nation is an island, my dear. Especially not a kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I was only asking a hypothetical q..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was only asking a hypothetical question."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree completely. GRACE is integ..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree completely. GRACE is integral to our survival as kingdoms."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They might.""
entries.dialogueText: "They might."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And if I want to become part of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "And if I want to become part of that democratized world?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice sniffed."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice sniffed.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""May you never have to put that the..."
entries.dialogueText: "May you never have to put that theory to the test."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Beatrice sniffed."
entries.dialogueText: Beatrice sniffed.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I do hope you're satisfied with th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do hope you're satisfied with the answer."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I'm terribly glad we are on the sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm terribly glad we are on the same page."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I suggest you first think long and..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suggest you first think long and hard about the consequences."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked at me in surprise."
entries.dialogueText: She looked at me in surprise.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My new security councilor is just..."
entries.dialogueText: "My new security councilor is just as capable. If not more so."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Ah, yes. The commoner. One cannot..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ah, yes. The commoner. One cannot help but admire a man of such brute strength."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""By the way. How would you feel abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "By the way. How would you feel about the Grand Duchy of Pales joining GRACE?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How is everyone else in GRACE?""
entries.dialogueText: "How is everyone else in GRACE?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh, just fine. A little rebellion..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, just fine. A little rebellion here and there, but nothing to worry about."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Where are all the other cars?""
entries.dialogueText: "Where are all the other cars?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Why, I'm always happy to add more..."
entries.dialogueText: "Why, I'm always happy to add more members to our exclusive club."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Especially ones with such prodigio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Especially ones with such prodigious natural gas reserves."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""As long as they are not too closel..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as they are not too closely enmeshed with ATO, that is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can sway the Duke away from Lesp..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can sway the Duke away from Lespia. I am confident of it."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I've had the entire freeway cleare..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've had the entire freeway cleared of traffic, of course. Rumburg spares no expense for visiting allies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If Rumburg can get good gas prices..."
entries.dialogueText: "If Rumburg can get good gas prices out of the bargain, does it matter?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""A very intriguing proposition. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "A very intriguing proposition. You must let me know how it goes."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""No, I suppose not.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, I suppose not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have a plan. Don't forget that V..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have a plan. Don't forget that Vina is still single."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh, my. Uniting Rumburg, Pales and..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, my. Uniting Rumburg, Pales and Rizia under one family crest would be an exciting feat indeed."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Sordland has trouble with us, dear..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland has trouble with us, dear Romus. Not the other way around."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Sordland has trouble with us, dear..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland has trouble with us, dear Romus. Not the other way around."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Sordland has trouble with us, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "Sordland has trouble with us, Mr. Esquibel. Not the other way around."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Though I must say Rizia is barely..."
entries.dialogueText: "Though I must say Rizia is barely any better in that regard."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And put an embargo on us as part o..."
entries.dialogueText: "And put an embargo on us as part of his silly little 'emergency'."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""His decision to aid Wehlen in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "His decision to aid Wehlen in the slaughter of the poor, beleaguered Bluds... despicable."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Frankly, Your Majesty, the fact th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Frankly, Your Majesty, the fact that Rizia is maintaining its connections to Sordland amounts to a betrayal in my eyes."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not a fan of President Rayne,..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not a fan of President Rayne, either. But I've got to honor the deals I made with his predecessor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Call me crazy, but I trust Rayne...."
entries.dialogueText: "Call me crazy, but I trust Rayne. There's just something about him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I haven't liked President Ray..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I haven't liked President Rayne since his dealings with Gasom. Alphonso had the stage set for us to invest, then Rayne tore it all down."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""That alone is proof that Sordland..."
entries.dialogueText: "That alone is proof that Sordland can no longer be trusted. If it ever could."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And then their President Rayne had..."
entries.dialogueText: "And then their President Rayne had the nerve to retaliate by shutting down the Sordish Consulate in Dome..."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And then their President Rayne had..."
entries.dialogueText: "And then their President Rayne had the nerve to condemn us..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucita looked bemused. She nodded a..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucita looked bemused. She nodded at Beatrice to continue.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Laurento looked distressed. He nodd..."
entries.dialogueText: Laurento looked distressed. He nodded at Beatrice to continue.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I do see potential in your gas dea..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do see potential in your gas deal with them. But even there, you must tread carefully."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I'm happy you weren't foolish enou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy you weren't foolish enough to accept any of their offers. One shouldn't get into bed with a country like that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's mutual, isn't it? The Sords t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's mutual, isn't it? The Sords turned down *our* opportunity to invest in Gasom."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Indeed. Proof of their renewed pre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed. Proof of their renewed prejudice against monarchies."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The Gasom deal has been lucrative..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Gasom deal has been lucrative for us both. We must be careful not to bite the hand that feeds us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not sure. We could have used t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not sure. We could have used the extra income."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your sister would've wanted it tha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your sister would've wanted it that way."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Ha! Yes, she would have.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ha! Yes, she would have."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Believe me, it would not have been..."
entries.dialogueText: "Believe me, it would not have been worth it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This is Rumburg's vendetta. It doe..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is Rumburg's vendetta. It doesn't concern my kingdom at all."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Oh, for heaven's--""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, for heaven's--"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We have no other ties. The Gasom d..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have no other ties. The Gasom deal is just cold, hard business."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""They may not be feeding us for lon..."
entries.dialogueText: "They may not be feeding us for long. You know that Rayne is facing pressure from his party to shut foreign investors out of Sordish energy companies."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It might not last long, by the way..."
entries.dialogueText: "It might not last long, by the way. You know that Rayne is facing pressure from his party to shut foreign investors out of Sordish energy companies."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She forced herself to take a deep b..."
entries.dialogueText: She forced herself to take a deep breath.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Have Rayne's Malenyevist leanings..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have Rayne's Malenyevist leanings not escaped your notice?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Have Rayne's Sollist leanings not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have Rayne's Sollist leanings not escaped your notice?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""And we are not even receiving part..."
entries.dialogueText: "And we are not even receiving particularly high returns."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Plenty of countries judge us for b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Plenty of countries judge us for being in bed with Rumburg."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""But I see your point.""
entries.dialogueText: "But I see your point."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""If you don't like the bed, you oug..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you don't like the bed, you ought to get out of it."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I respect that you are a man of yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I respect that you are a man of your word. But I fear that the Sordish president is not."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""He will stab both of our kingdoms..."
entries.dialogueText: "He will stab both of our kingdoms in the back with no hesitation. Mark my words."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It may not appear so at the moment..."
entries.dialogueText: "It may not appear so at the moment, but Rayne is most certainly up to something."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Have Rayne's pro-Arcasian leanings..."
entries.dialogueText: "Have Rayne's pro-Arcasian leanings not escaped your notice?"

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""Good luck winning your war once So..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good luck winning your war once Sordland joins ATO, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""We'll show them who's in the right.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll show them who's in the right."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I can only hope that the Sords ref..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can only hope that the Sords refrain from further provocation. Nobody wants another conflict in Merkopa."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She calmly poured herself a glass o..."
entries.dialogueText: She calmly poured herself a glass of sparkling water from the limousine's minibar.

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""I can only hope that the Sords ref..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can only hope that the Sords refrain from further provocation. The last thing anyone wants is conflict."

entries.speaker: Beatrice Livingston
entries.title: Beatrice Livingston (R): ""It's true we closed our embassy in..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's true we closed our embassy in Lachaven. But that was a long-overdue response to the Republic's many attempts to isolate us."

entries.dialogueText: "Exactly."

entries.title: Laurento Esquibel: ""I understand you've been having so..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand you've been having some trouble with the republic lately?"

entries.dialogueText: "I wish you'd taken my advice about the Dastnurist community to heart. I hear Rumburg expatriates feel their freedom of religion is restricted."
